places.name: Postojna Cave Train Tour
places.ai_summary: A unique underground train ride through one of the world’s largest karst caves, featuring stunning stalactites and stalagmites.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available at specific times.

places.place_tip: Wear warm clothing as the cave is cool year-round.

places.name: Predjama Castle (Cliff Fortress)
places.ai_summary: A dramatic castle built into a cliff, known for its fascinating history and stunning views.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 30 minutes before closing.

places.place_tip: Explore the secret tunnels inside the castle.

places.name: Vivarium Proteus (Olm)
places.ai_summary: A fascinating aquarium and museum dedicated to the proteus anguinus, or olm, a blind salamander endemic to the karst caves of Slovenia.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available; photography not allowed.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn more about the olm and other cave dwellers.

places.ai_summary: An informative exhibition showcasing the unique geological and biological features of the Karst region.

opening_hours.notes: Interactive exhibits; suitable for all ages.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the 4D cinema experience about cave life.

places.ai_summary: A guided tour through two stunning caves known for their unique rock formations and underground rivers.

opening_hours.notes: Wear comfortable shoes; bring a flashlight.

places.place_tip: The caves are cooler, so a light jacket is recommended.

places.place_tip: Listen to the sound of the underground river during the walk.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed in spring and autumn.

places.place_tip: Check the lake's water level status before visiting.
